events.title: Discovery of Pluto
events.description: Astronomer Clyde Tombaugh, working at Lowell Observatory in Flagstaff, Arizona, identified Pluto by comparing photographic plates taken in January 1930. The discovery was announced publicly in March 1930.
events.significance: Pluto was classified as the ninth planet for 76 years until its reclassification as a dwarf planet in 2006, and its discovery reshaped understanding of the outer solar system and the Kuiper Belt.

events.title: Death of Martin Luther
events.description: German theologian and former Augustinian friar Martin Luther died in Eisleben, Saxony, at age 62, while visiting his birthplace to help mediate a dispute between local counts.
events.significance: Luther's 95 Theses of 1517 sparked the Protestant Reformation, which permanently divided Western Christianity and transformed European politics, culture, and education.

events.title: The Gambia Gains Independence
events.description: The Gambia became independent from the United Kingdom as a constitutional monarchy within the Commonwealth, with Dawda Jawara serving as prime minister. It became a republic in 1970.
events.significance: The Gambia's independence was part of the wave of decolonization across Africa in the 1960s, and it became one of the continent's smallest independent nations.

events.title: Publication of The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn in the United States
events.description: Mark Twain's novel was first published in the United States on this date, following its December 1884 release in the UK and Canada. It quickly drew both acclaim and controversy.
events.significance: Often called the Great American Novel, it pioneered the use of vernacular speech in American literature and remains a central, debated work for its treatment of race and society.

events.title: Snow Falls in the Sahara Desert
events.description: A rare snowstorm struck the town of Ain Sefra in Algeria, on the edge of the Sahara, covering sand dunes with snow for about half an hour.
events.significance: The event was one of the few recorded snowfalls in the Sahara, and it has become a notable example of extreme and unusual weather phenomena.
